source: If all active threads choose the same branch, the warp follows one path. If some threads choose A and others choose B, the warp has diverged. ZXNAME0000XZ’s execution model must account for both paths while enabling only the lanes that belong to the path currently being executed.[1]
zh: 如果所有活动线程选择同一分支，则扭曲遵循一条路径。如果一些线程选择 A 而其他线程选择 B，则经纱已发散。 ZXNAME0000XZ 的执行模型必须考虑两条路径，同时仅启用属于当前正在执行的路径的通道。[1]
